english.note: Use this specifically for the hollow stem of the plant, rather than the whole plant or a musical-instrument reed.

examples.english: A reed stem is usually hollow and can be used to make a simple instrument.
examples.traditional: 蘆葦莖通常係中空嘅，可用於製作簡單樂器。
